summary: All 51 requirements are implemented in 15 Java files under lre/ (controller, mode enum, constants, sensor with obstacle register, actuator, five operations, sealed input/output events, annotation). Behaviour checked with a scratch scenario run (24 checks pass). Twelve points the requirements did not settle are listed below; none blocks the pipeline.

issues.title: No-obstacle index is 0, not -1
issues.raw: LRE-DM5, LRE-Var5, LRE-Var6, LRE-OP3 and LRE-OP4 say closestStaticIndex()/closestDynamicIndex() return -1 when no obstacle exists, but also call cstc and cdyn natural numbers; the Java profile maps int to nat and forbids negative values.
issues.fix_directive: Sensor.NO_OBSTACLE = 0 is the 'none' index; ObstacleRegister rejects identifier 0, so every real obstacle has an index of at least 1 and index 0 always reads as absent (safe large distance, zero fields). Change only if the requirements allow a different sentinel.

issues.title: Value of the 'safe large distance'
issues.raw: LRE-DM5: when no obstacle exists, odist, hdist and vdist return a safe large distance. No value is given.
issues.fix_directive: SAFE_DISTANCE = 1000000.0 m (private to Sensor), far above every threshold (all 1 m).

issues.title: CPA formula: horizontal plane, velocity relative to the AUV
issues.raw: LRE-OP5 names cda and tcpa and says CalcCPA reads the obstacle's relative position and velocity from the Sensor, but gives no formula. LRE-DM2 calls obs_ns_vel/obs_ew_vel the obstacle's velocity (not relative).
issues.fix_directive: Standard relative-motion CPA in the horizontal plane: r = (nsRelDist, ewRelDist), v = (obsNsVel - nsVel, obsEwVel - ewVel), tcpa = -(r.v)/(|v|^2 + CPA_EPSILON), cda = |r + v*tcpa| + (hdist(cdyn) - |r|). Using relative velocity lets an AUV manoeuvre change cda; the vertical components (obs_roc, depths) are not used because the Sensor exposes no vertical field accessors.

issues.title: No dynamic obstacle: zero field defaults would give cda = 0
issues.raw: LRE-DM5 says nsRelDist/ewRelDist/obsNsVel/obsEwVel return zero when no obstacle exists; LRE-OP5 says the Sensor returns 'zero-velocity and large-distance defaults' so that the no-dynamic-obstacle case is safe. With zero relative distances any CPA formula built only from the field accessors gives cda = 0 and a phantom collision.
issues.fix_directive: Kept the DM5 zero defaults and brought the large distance in through hdist: the term (hdist(cdyn) - sqrt(nsRelDist^2 + ewRelDist^2)) is exactly 0.0 when the obstacle exists (the Sensor computes hdist with the same expression) and SAFE_DISTANCE when it does not, so cda is large and neither MOM_to_CAM nor HCM_to_CAM fires, and CAM_to_OCM_safe can fire once the obstacle is gone.

issues.title: CPA_EPSILON keeps tcpa's division defined
issues.raw: tcpa divides by the squared relative speed, which is zero when there is no dynamic obstacle and the AUV is stationary, or when an obstacle moves with the AUV.
issues.fix_directive: CPA_EPSILON = 0.000000001 m^2/s^2 is added to the denominator (negligible against any real relative speed). It is fractional, so the model's constants interface rounds it up to 1; no guard compares against it.

issues.title: CheckOPEZ and CalcCPA read the closest-obstacle index from the Sensor
issues.raw: LRE-OP2: CheckOPEZ uses the index computed by CalcCStc; LRE-OP5: CalcCPA uses cdyn from CalcCDyn. The profile lets an operation's compute() use only sensor calls, constants and its own fields.
issues.fix_directive: CheckOPEZ calls sensor.odist(sensor.closestStaticIndex()) and CalcCPA calls sensor.closestDynamicIndex(), the same functions CalcCStc and CalcCDyn assign to cstc and cdyn on the same sensor state, so the indices are equal. The controller runs CalcCStc before CheckOPEZ and CalcCDyn before CalcCPA.

issues.title: Transition priority within MOM and HCM
issues.raw: All LRE-Beh requirements have priority 8, so the order inside each mode is not given. In the model the branches are alternatives, so each branch below a guard-only branch conjoins its negation.
issues.fix_directive: MOM: reqOCM, inOpez, endTask, collision course (CAM), Beh9, Beh11, Beh10, reqHCM. HCM: reqOCM, inOpez, collision course (CAM), Beh13. CAM: reqOCM, Beh18. reqOCM comes first in every mode it applies to (operator override); Beh11 is placed before Beh10 because with staticObsVertDist = staticObsDfltVertDist = 1 the reverse order makes Beh11's guard unsatisfiable. Each source/trigger pair has one transition (LRE-DC1).

issues.title: Constants for values the transitions fix inline
issues.raw: LRE-Beh4 (vel <= 1, odist > 1), LRE-Beh9/Beh11 (hvel, vvel >= 1), LRE-FR2 (advVel 1), LRE-FR3 (advVel 0), LRE-Beh7/Beh18 (advVel 0) fix numbers that LRE-DM4 does not name.
issues.fix_directive: Named them VEL_LIMIT, MOM_ENTRY_MIN_DIST, MOM_VELOCITY, HCM_VELOCITY and STOP_VELOCITY in LreConstants, with the values the requirements give. All are whole numbers, so the model's rounding does not change them.

issues.title: HCM advised velocity: 0 m/s or 0.1 m/s
issues.raw: LRE-FR3: on entering HCM the LRE advises 0 m/s. The system description says HCM runs at reduced speed (0.1 m/s).

issues.title: CAM's evasive manoeuvre is not specified
issues.raw: LRE-FR4: in CAM the AUV performs evasive manoeuvres. No advised velocity or heading is given, and no requirement gives CAM an exit on inOpez.
issues.fix_directive: CAM issues no advice of its own and ignores operator velocity and heading (LRE-Beh19). It is left only by reqOCM (Beh17) or by cda >= minSafeDist (Beh18). Add an entry action if the manoeuvre is specified.

issues.title: vvel is the signed rate of climb
issues.raw: LRE-OP1: vvel is the rate of climb. LRE-Beh11 tests vvel >= 1, which a fast descent never meets.
issues.fix_directive: vvel = rateOfClimb() as written (signed, positive when climbing). A descent towards a static obstacle is still caught by Beh10 (vdist alone). Use the magnitude instead if that is the intent.

issues.title: Cycle without operator input; initial readings
issues.raw: The requirements do not say how an autonomous cycle is signalled or what the sensor reads before its first update.
issues.fix_directive: A cycle with no operator input is step(null), so only guard-only transitions can fire. Sensor readings and operation results start at 0 / false / NO_OBSTACLE; the environment is expected to update the Sensor before each step.

next_step: Run the pipeline (compile, coverage, profile check, transformations, FDR4, Dafny, Isabelle, vacuity) and fix the Java from its reports.
